Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّاۤ اَرۡسَلۡنَا نُوۡحًا اِلٰى قَوۡمِهٖۤ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرۡ قَوۡمَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ يَّاۡتِيَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely We sent Nuh (Noah) to his people: ‘Warn your people before a painful torment comes upon them.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اِنِّىۡ لَـكُمۡ نَذِيۡرٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He said: ‘O my people! Indeed I am a clear Warner to you,

Verses.VerseAr: اَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡا اللّٰهَ وَاتَّقُوۡهُ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: That you must worship Allah and fear Him and obey me.

Verses.VerseAr: يَغۡفِرۡ لَـكُمۡ مِّنۡ ذُنُوۡبِكُمۡ وَيُؤَخِّرۡكُمۡ اِلٰٓى اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ؕ اِنَّ اَجَلَ اللّٰهِ اِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ‌‌ۘ لَوۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He will forgive your sins and will give you respite till an appointed term. Surely when (the appointed) time of Allah comes then respite is not given if only you knew.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّىۡ دَعَوۡتُ قَوۡمِىۡ لَيۡلاً وَّنَهَارًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) submitted: ‘O my Lord! Indeed I kept calling my people night and day,

Verses.VerseAr: فَلَمۡ يَزِدۡهُمۡ دُعَآءِىۡۤ اِلَّا فِرَارًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: But my calling did no good except making them flee away.

Verses.VerseAr: وَاِنِّىۡ كُلَّمَا دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ لِتَغۡفِرَ لَهُمۡ جَعَلُوۡۤا اَصَابِعَهُمۡ فِىۡۤ اٰذَانِهِمۡ وَاسۡتَغۡشَوۡا ثِيَابَهُمۡ وَاَصَرُّوۡا وَاسۡتَكۡبَرُوۡا اسۡتِكۡبَارًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And every time I called them (towards faith) so that You forgive them, they only thrust their fingers into their ears and wrapped their clothes over themselves and stuck obstinately (to disbelief) and behaved most arrogantly.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنِّىۡ دَعَوۡتُهُمۡ جِهَارًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then I called them aloud.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ اِنِّىۡۤ اَعۡلَـنۡتُ لَهُمۡ وَاَسۡرَرۡتُ لَهُمۡ اِسۡرَارًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then I advised them publicly and privately and secretly (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: فَقُلۡتُ اسۡتَغۡفِرُوۡا رَبَّكُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ غَفَّارًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then I said: ‘Seek forgiveness from your Lord. Surely He is Most Forgiving.

Verses.VerseAr: يُّرۡسِلِ السَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّدۡرَارًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: He will send down on you torrents of rain,

Verses.VerseAr: وَّيُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ بِاَمۡوَالٍ وَّبَنِيۡنَ وَيَجۡعَل لَّـكُمۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّيَجۡعَل لَّـكُمۡ اَنۡهٰرًاؕ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And will help you with wealth and sons and will grow for you gardens and will make streams flow for you.

Verses.VerseAr: مَّا لَـكُمۡ لَا تَرۡجُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ وَقَارًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: What is the matter with you that you do not have faith in or the gnosis of Allah’s Majesty,

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَدۡ خَلَقَكُمۡ اَطۡوَارًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Whereas He has created you through diverse conditions?

Verses.VerseAr: اَلَمۡ تَرَوۡا كَيۡفَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ سَبۡعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Have you not seen how Allah has created seven (or many) heavenly spheres corresponding to one another (layer upon layer)?

Verses.VerseAr: وَجَعَلَ الۡقَمَرَ فِيۡهِنَّ نُوۡرًاۙ وَّجَعَلَ الشَّمۡسَ سِرَاجًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And He brightened in them the moon and made the sun a radiant lamp (i.e. the source of light and heat).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۡۢبَتَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَرۡضِ نَبَاتًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has caused you to grow like vegetation from the earth.

Verses.VerseAr: ثُمَّ يُعِيۡدُكُمۡ فِيۡهَا وَيُخۡرِجُكُمۡ اِخۡرَاجًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Then He will return you into the same (earth) and will then bring you forth (from the same again).

Verses.VerseAr: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَـكُمُ الۡاَرۡضَ بِسَاطًاۙ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Allah has made the earth a vast expanse for you,

Verses.VerseAr: لِّـتَسۡلُكُوۡا مِنۡهَا سُبُلاً فِجَاجًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: So that you may move around through its broad ways.’

Verses.VerseAr: قَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ اِنَّهُمۡ عَصَوۡنِىۡ وَاتَّبَعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّمۡ يَزِدۡهُ مَالُهٗ وَوَلَدُهٗۤ اِلَّا خَسَارًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: Nuh (Noah) submitted: ‘O my Lord! They have disobeyed me and kept following that (class of the rebellious rich) whose wealth and children have not increased for them anything but loss.

Verses.VerseAr: وَمَكَرُوۡا مَكۡرًا كُبَّارًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they kept perpetrating huge frauds (to keep the common man in error).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالُوۡا لَا تَذَرُنَّ اٰلِهَتَكُمۡ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَّلَا سُوَاعًا ۙ وَّلَا يَغُوۡثَ وَيَعُوۡقَ وَنَسۡرًا‌ۚ‏
Verses.VerseEn: And they kept saying: Do not turn away from your gods and never abandon (the idols named as) Wadd, Suwa‘, Yaghuth, Ya‘uq and Nasr (as well).

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَدۡ اَضَلُّوۡا كَثِيۡرًا‌ ‌ۚ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا ضَلٰلاً‏
Verses.VerseEn: And truly they have misled many people. So, (O my Lord,) do not increase these wrongdoers (in anything) except misguidance.’

Verses.VerseAr: مِّمَّا خَطٓيْئٰتِهِمۡ اُغۡرِقُوۡا فَاُدۡخِلُوۡا نَارًا ۙ فَلَمۡ يَجِدُوۡا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اَنۡصَارًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: (In the end) they were drowned due to their sins and then flung into the Fire. So they could not find any helper for themselves against Allah.

Verses.VerseAr: وَقَالَ نُوۡحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرۡ عَلَى الۡاَرۡضِ مِنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ دَيَّارًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: And Nuh (Noah) submitted: ‘O my Lord! Do not leave even a single disbeliever living on earth.

Verses.VerseAr: اِنَّكَ اِنۡ تَذَرۡهُمۡ يُضِلُّوۡا عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوۡۤا اِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: Surely if You leave them (alive) they will keep leading your servants astray and will beget none but the most wicked and extremely disbelieving children.

Verses.VerseAr: رَّبِّ اغۡفِرۡ لِىۡ وَلِـوَالِدَىَّ وَلِمَنۡ دَخَلَ بَيۡتِىَ مُؤۡمِنًا وَّلِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ وَالۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِؕ وَلَا تَزِدِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ اِلَّا تَبَارًا‏
Verses.VerseEn: O my Lord! Forgive me and my parents and everyone who enters my home as a believer and (all) the believing men and the believing women and do not increase anything for the wrongdoers except destruction.’
